description: Two independent ring modulators, each crossfading its carrier with the product of carrier and modulator

params.text: Crossfades that section's output from the plain carrier to the ring-modulated signal.

inputs.text: The carrier of that section; it is what the output carries with MIX fully counter-clockwise.
The modulator of that section, multiplied with the carrier to make the ring-modulated signal.
Moves that section's MIX 10% towards the ring-modulated signal per volt.

outputs.text: That section's carrier and ring-modulated signal blended by its MIX knob.
